description: This file contains unit tests for the BuzzLikeOnShareAPI class in the OrangeHRM system. It tests the API endpoints related to liking shares in the Buzz module, including retrieving all likes, creating a new like, and deleting a like. The tests utilize mock services and fixture data to verify correct behavior.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareAPITest
classes.description: A test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase, containing tests for the BuzzLikeOnShareAPI's getAll, create, and delete methods.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all 'like' records for shares using the API.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new 'like' record via the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the deletion of a 'like' record via the API.

methods.description: Provides test case data for testing the getAll method.
